EY Interview Experience.
Compensation: 27 LPA
Position: Data Engineer

𝟭𝘀𝘁 𝗥𝗼𝘂𝗻𝗱 – 𝗦𝗽𝗮𝗿𝗸 + 𝗣𝘆𝘁𝗵𝗼𝗻 + 𝗦𝗤𝗟 (𝗟𝟭 𝗧𝗲𝗰𝗵𝗻𝗶𝗰𝗮𝗹 𝗥𝗼𝘂𝗻𝗱)

Spark:
- Repartition vs Coalesce
- Read Modes in Spark
- map vs flatMap
- Shared Variables

PySpark Coding:
- Calculate min/max marks per student from subject-wise score columns using least() and greatest()

Python:
- Inheritance behavior with Parent and Child classes
- Effects of overriding variables across instances

SQL:
- For each date, return product count and names sold — GROUP_CONCAT() + COUNT(DISTINCT)

𝟮𝗻𝗱 𝗥𝗼𝘂𝗻𝗱 – 𝗦𝗤𝗟 + 𝗣𝘆𝗦𝗽𝗮𝗿𝗸 (𝗟𝟮 𝗧𝗲𝗰𝗵𝗻𝗶𝗰𝗮𝗹 𝗥𝗼𝘂𝗻𝗱)

SQL:
- Symmetric difference between two tables using UNION of NOT IN queries
Highest salary per department using DENSE_RANK()

PySpark:
- Remove duplicates using ROW_NUMBER() over name partition
Kept only row_number = 1 rows

𝟯𝗿𝗱 𝗥𝗼𝘂𝗻𝗱 – 𝗖𝗹𝗶𝗲𝗻𝘁 𝗥𝗼𝘂𝗻𝗱 (𝗣𝗿𝗼𝗷𝗲𝗰𝘁 + 𝗦𝗰𝗲𝗻𝗮𝗿𝗶𝗼-𝗕𝗮𝘀𝗲𝗱 𝗤𝘀)

Spark Theoretical:
- Optimization techniques in Spark
- What are Delta Tables
- Delta vs Parquet
- How does Databricks Catalog work
- Initial vs Incremental loads
- Data loss prevention strategies

Project Discussion:
- Faced challenges and how they were solved
- Emphasis on real project ownership

PySpark Task:
- Given process(year, month, day, flag, units) table
- For each date: compute total units and count of flagged IDs
- Used groupBy on year, month, day with sum(units) and count(flag) aggregations
